title: How Django picks which frontend build/assets to serve (DEBUG vs prod, JS_URL, preload manifest)
answers: How does the backend choose which built assets to serve?
Do feature flags or query params switch frontend builds?
Where are preload hints for index.html computed?
body:
No feature-flag/query-param build switch exists; only `settings.DEBUG and not settings.TEST` and `JS_URL`.
- Templates: `TEMPLATES[0]['DIRS']=['frontend/dist','posthog/templates']` in posthog/settings/web.py; static `STATIC_URL='/static/'`, `STATICFILES_DIRS=[frontend/dist]` (+ frontend/public in DEBUG). Rendered by `render_template`/`get_context_for_template` in posthog/utils.py.
- Bundle by template name: build side `writeIndexHtml`/`writeExporterHtml`/`writeRenderQueryHtml` in frontend/build.mjs → `copyIndexHtml` (common/esbuilder/utils.mjs). index.html/layout.html→`index`, exporter.html→`exporter`, render_query.html→`render-query`.
- Dev: `_build_template_context` (posthog/utils.py) sets `debug`, `git_branch`, `vite_dev_scripts` (maps exporter.html→src/exporter/index.tsx, render_query.html→src/render-query/index.tsx, else src/index.tsx); posthog/templates/head.html emits them only `{% if debug %}` and sets `window.JS_URL`.
- `get_js_url` rewrites localhost JS_URL host to the request host in DEBUG unless HTTPS.
- Prod preload: `_resolve_entry_assets(include_authenticated_shell)` (lru_cache maxsize=2) reads frontend/dist/preload-manifest.json via `_read_preload_manifest`; empty in DEBUG/TEST/missing file; only for template_name=='index.html'; `authenticatedJs` only if request.user.is_authenticated. Fills preload_css_url/preload_js_urls/preload_font_url used in frontend/src/index.html.
